svg.title: Non-grid known-best contact-assembly evidence profile
svg.desc: Thirty-six calibration cases from n equals 1 through 100. Bars show the share of squares in detected same-angle positive-edge contact components. This is a descriptive numerical census, not a rigidity, optimality, or hypothesis verdict.
svg.text: 1,780/1,860 squares in 169 same-angle contact components · 25/36 cases within C≤6, F≤3
10 fully covered · 27 at least 90% · 33 at least 75% · 35 at least 50%

K = retained Kingbird-derived numerical facts · U = six-decimal UnitSquare rendering-derived normalization · C = multi-square contact components · F = free squares · orange outline = detector-sensitive row
Primary detector: same fitted angle, positive edge overlap, contact residual ≤ 0.001. Connectedness is not rigidity; slide counts precede overlap intervals and wall seating.
Calibration only. No claim of global optimality, complete chunk grammar, or H-044 verdict.
